column1: # Suite census — one row per test root per occasion. Append-only; never rewrite a row.
# Occasion: the pre-merge live-deploy gate (orchestrator-role.md -> Document-Driven Workflow step 6),
#   at the point the combined tree is deployed and run-bats-parallel.sh is run before the PR opens.
# Five roots, not four: run-bats-parallel.sh recurses only the first four and monitor/test is absent
#   from the live install, so a census keyed to the runner reproduces the blind spot it exists to watch.
# This is a RECORD, never a gate: no threshold, no CI failure on growth. Honor-system, like the rest of step 6.
# Command: see .claude/prompt-audit/evidence/ledger.md -> "Suite census" (single copy, not duplicated here).
# The first three rows are a BACKFILL of the CI diet, computed with git grep over each commit's tree.
